name: worktreeguard-codex
description: Codex hooks and a bundled local command for WorktreeGuard-protected Git worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex writes out of protected base checkouts.
interface.longDescription: Installs Codex lifecycle hooks plus a bundled local WorktreeGuard command so Git main worktrees are protected by default, linked worktrees remain writable, and human-approved base access grants are honored.
defaultPrompt: Use WorktreeGuard before editing this repo.
